subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 6: Culture and Project – National animals
outcomes: Find facts about the ring-tailed lemur, the Arabian oryx and the Komodo dragon.
Compare national animals of different countries.
Write notes about national animals and use but to show contrast.

tf.s: The Arabian oryx is the national animal of Oman.
tf.why: Yes, the oryx is Oman's national animal.

tf.s: The ring-tailed lemur is the national animal of Madagascar.
The Arabian oryx has black fur.
Ring-tailed lemurs live in the wild in Oman.
The Arabian oryx must drink water every day.
tf.why: It gets the water it needs from its food.

tf.s: The Komodo dragon is the national animal of Indonesia.
Some Komodo dragons can be three metres long.
tf.why: Yes, it is the largest lizard.

tf.s: The Komodo dragon is a small bird.
tf.why: It is a very big lizard.

tf.s: We use but to join two ideas that are different.
You don't need to check how to say country names before you present.
tf.why: It is good to check the pronunciation first.

boxes.q: What colour is the Arabian oryx's fur?
boxes.why: The oryx has beautiful white fur.

boxes.q: Which country has the ring-tailed lemur as its national animal?
How long can some Komodo dragons be?
Which word joins two different ideas?
Where does the Arabian oryx live?
boxes.why: The oryx lives in the desert.

boxes.q: Which national animal is a lizard?
boxes.why: The Komodo dragon is the largest lizard.

boxes.q: What does a ring-tailed lemur have on its tail?
boxes.why: Its tail is striped black and white.

boxes.q: Which animal is the national animal of the USA?
boxes.why: The bald eagle is on the model note.

boxes.q: What should a note about a national animal include?
boxes.why: Notes are short but give key facts.

hunt.q: Komodo dragons taste the air with their …
Length of a big Komodo dragon
The oryx gets water from its …

mcq.q: Which animal is the largest lizard in the world?
mcq.why: The Komodo dragon is the largest lizard.

mcq.q: How does the Arabian oryx get water in the desert?
mcq.why: It gets all the water it needs from its food.

mcq.q: How does the Komodo dragon find animals?
o: It tastes the air with its tongue.
It listens with its big ears.
mcq.why: Its tongue helps it find food.

mcq.q: Which three countries are in the culture text?
mcq.why: The text is about these three countries.

mcq.q: Join with but: The oryx lives in the desert. / It doesn't need to drink water.
o: The oryx lives in the desert, but it doesn't need to drink water.
The oryx lives in the desert but, it doesn't need to drink water.
But the oryx lives in the desert it doesn't need to drink water.
The oryx but lives in the desert, it doesn't need to drink water.
mcq.why: Put a comma, then but, between the two ideas.

o: Kiwis are small, but they lay very big eggs.
Kiwis are small, but they are small.
Kiwis are small, but they are little birds.
Kiwis lay eggs, but they lay eggs.
mcq.why: But joins two different, surprising ideas.

mcq.q: Which is a good project note?
o: Bald eagle – USA – big wings and a white head
mcq.why: A good note has the name, country and features.

mcq.q: Why is the Arabian oryx well suited to life in the desert?
o: It doesn't need to drink water often.
It has a long striped tail.
It tastes the air with its tongue.
mcq.why: Getting water from food helps it in a dry place.

mcq.q: Which national animal from the text would be the most dangerous to touch?
mcq.why: It is very big and has venom.

mcq.q: A student says: 'The Komodo dragon is amazing.' Which reason is best?
o: Because it is the largest lizard and has venom.
mcq.why: A good reason uses true facts from the text.
